about: IEA Wind Data Catalogue — canonical record schema. Nothing in this repository consumes this file yet: it is the written definition of the record shape (plan §2.2), it documents every custom field carried in `extras`, and it is the input ckanext-scheming needs on the day the catalogue is promoted to CKAN. Keep it in step with harvest/materialize.py:EXTRA_KEYS and harvest/CONTRACT.md — those three are the same contract stated three ways.
notes: Every custom field below is stored as a CKAN EXTRA with a STRING value. Fields whose logical type is a list or an object are JSON-encoded inside that string, compactly, with sorted keys. CKAN accepts nothing else in extras unless declared here, which is exactly what this file declares.

Records are never edited in place. `source.*` metadata is replaced wholesale on a source-key change; `local.*` annotation is additive (ADR-0038). The event log in events/ is the source of truth; records/*.json is a derived view.
Withdrawal is NOT CKAN `state: deleted` — that would hide and permit purging a record ADR-0027 requires be retained. Withdrawal is `lifecycle_state`, `withdrawn` and `withdrawn_at` below.

dataset_fields.label: Title
dataset_fields.help_text: Never edited. If the source has a typo, that is what the source says; attach a curator note instead (plan §4.3).

dataset_fields.label: URL slug
dataset_fields.help_text: Derived deterministically from the identity key, never from the title, so a retitled artifact keeps its citable URL.

dataset_fields.label: Description
dataset_fields.help_text: Verbatim source abstract, sanitised to a safe HTML subset. Never model-generated prose.

dataset_fields.label: Licence
dataset_fields.help_text: Mapped through harvest/licenses.py. Unmappable input becomes 'notspecified' AND is flagged in the run report — never silently defaulted to something open.

dataset_fields.label: Organization
dataset_fields.help_text: Must exist in organizations.yaml.

dataset_fields.label: Tags
dataset_fields.help_text: Alphanumerics, '-', '_' and '.', 2-100 characters each.

dataset_fields.label: Identity key
dataset_fields.help_text: The catalogue's notion of 'the same artifact'. Lowercase-normalised DOI when one exists; else source_system|source_id; else hash|<16 hex> of normalised title + first author + year (fragile).

dataset_fields.label: Identity derivation
dataset_fields.help_text: How the identity key was derived. 'fragile' records are the ones a corrected upstream title would split in two.

choices.label: Hash of title, author and year (fragile)

dataset_fields.label: DOI
dataset_fields.help_text: Bare lowercase form, e.g. 10.5281/zenodo.1234567. Every DOI in a record has been resolved against DataCite or Crossref; non-resolving DOIs cause the record to be dropped and logged.

dataset_fields.label: Source system
dataset_fields.help_text: The adapter that most recently scraped this record.

dataset_fields.label: Contributing source systems
dataset_fields.help_text: JSON string: sorted list of every source that has described this identity. Four entries for a four-way merge (fixture x-01).

dataset_fields.label: Source identifier
dataset_fields.help_text: The upstream system's own identifier, as a string.

dataset_fields.label: Source key
dataset_fields.help_text: The record-level change token (plan §4.1). Semantics are owned by the adapter. Displayed in the mono face as provenance, not as a user-facing identifier.

dataset_fields.label: Source URL
dataset_fields.help_text: Primary upstream landing page.

dataset_fields.label: Source URLs
dataset_fields.help_text: JSON string: every upstream landing page for this identity. SET-VALUED — unions across sources, never displaces.

dataset_fields.label: IEA Wind Task
dataset_fields.help_text: JSON string: sorted list of group names, e.g. ["task-43","task-49"]. SET-VALUED — a source adding a task must never erase a hand-attributed one (ADR-0038, fixture x-04). Values must exist in groups.yaml; renumbering aliases (19->54, 34->59) resolve first.

dataset_fields.label: Resource kind
dataset_fields.help_text: Often classified rather than stated. Where classified by a model, provenance records extraction_method 'llm' and the record page shows a machine-inferred badge.

dataset_fields.label: Access
dataset_fields.help_text: Availability honesty (fixtures zen-05, zen-06, osti-04, wdh-06). Never imply a file is downloadable when it is not.

dataset_fields.label: Embargo lifts
dataset_fields.help_text: ISO 8601. Re-checked after the date passes.

dataset_fields.label: Creators
dataset_fields.help_text: JSON string: list of {name, given?, family?, orcid?, affiliation?}. `name` is the only guaranteed key — Crossref emits collaboration entries with no given name (fixture cr-06).

dataset_fields.label: Published
dataset_fields.help_text: ISO 8601, possibly year-only. A year-only source date stays year-only; never fabricate a month or day (fixture cr-02).

dataset_fields.label: Report number
dataset_fields.help_text: The issuing laboratory's report number, e.g. NREL/TP-5000-89937. For grey literature with no DOI this is the only stable human-facing identifier there is, so it is carried as a first-class field and shown in the citation block (fixture osti-05).

dataset_fields.label: Related identifiers
dataset_fields.help_text: JSON string: list of {relation, identifier, identifier_type}. Used for version resolution and preprint/dataset linking. Records are NOT created for the targets (fixture dc-06).

dataset_fields.label: Licence, as stated at source
dataset_fields.help_text: Verbatim. Retained even when it maps cleanly, so a disputed mapping is checkable.

dataset_fields.label: Licence mapped
dataset_fields.help_text: 'false' means the source stated something the lookup table did not recognise. license_id is then 'notspecified' and the run report flags it.

dataset_fields.label: Field provenance
dataset_fields.help_text: JSON string: {field: {extraction_method: api|pattern|llm, model?, prompt_version?, confidence?, source_system?, pinned?}}. Fields with extraction_method 'llm' render with a visible machine-inferred badge (ADR-0028, fixture x-05). This is the field that makes the catalogue credible to a FAIR-literate audience; do not omit it.

dataset_fields.label: Lifecycle
dataset_fields.help_text: NOT CKAN's `state`. A withdrawn record is retained with its URL intact so existing citations survive (ADR-0027, fixtures zen-12, r-04).

dataset_fields.label: Withdrawn at
dataset_fields.help_text: Our observation time, not the source's. ISO 8601 UTC.

dataset_fields.label: First seen
dataset_fields.help_text: Observation time of the first event for this identity. Survives version drift (fixture zen-03).

dataset_fields.label: Last seen
dataset_fields.help_text: Observation time of the most recent event. NOT the last run time — an unchanged record writes no event (ADR-0026).

dataset_fields.label: Curator notes
dataset_fields.help_text: JSON string: list of {field?, note, added_at?}. LOCAL-ONLY and never displaced by a source. Where upstream is known wrong and will not be fixed, the wrong value is displayed verbatim with the note beside it — both truths on the page (plan §4.3, fixture x-10).

dataset_fields.label: Curator links
dataset_fields.help_text: JSON string: list of {url, label}. Cross-record relationships and context a curator added.

dataset_fields.label: Suppressed
dataset_fields.help_text: Local annotation: a noise record, retained but not listed.

dataset_fields.label: Pinned extraction
dataset_fields.help_text: A human corrected a Tier-3 extraction. The pin HOLDS when the page's content hash later changes, and a pin_notice fires for a human to adjudicate (plan §4.3, fixture x-09).

resource_fields.label: URL
resource_fields.help_text: A link upstream. The catalogue never mirrors files — metadata and links only.

resource_fields.label: Version DOI
resource_fields.help_text: For a Zenodo concept record, each version appears here as a resource. The catalogue holds one record per concept, never one per version (fixture zen-02).
